summary: Frontend-only verification of three additive UI changes (homepage incentives widget, Business Onboarding business-model help, Admin Analytics 'Promotions & Earnings' card). All four review-request items now pass after fixing one critical missing import in AdminPanel.js that crashed the entire Analytics tab.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED by testing agent: <AnalyticsPromotions/> was rendered at line 1172 of AdminPanel.js but the component was never imported, causing an UNCAUGHT runtime error ('ReferenceError: AnalyticsPromotions is not defined') that white-screened the entire Admin Analytics tab. Added 'import AnalyticsPromotions from ./AnalyticsPromotions;' at the top of the file.

action_items: Main agent: please review/keep the import fix in /app/frontend/src/AdminPanel.js (line ~8: 'import AnalyticsPromotions from ./AnalyticsPromotions;'). Without it the entire Admin Analytics tab crashes with a React ReferenceError.

Optional: there are pre-existing 500s on /api/admin/applications (Error fetching applications: AxiosError) when loading /admin — not part of this task but noisy in console. Worth investigating in a follow-up.

The new Earn-with-IslandHop widget on the homepage was confirmed to lay out as a single horizontal band at 1920px (all 4 cards at top=495px). Good responsive grid usage.
BusinessOnboarding legend is well-implemented: description + optionDescriptions rendered through a generic renderField helper, so adding 'help' to other selects is now trivial.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 review-request UI features verified on preview URL https://logistics-island.preview.emergentagent.com. (1) Homepage incentives-widget renders horizontally with all 4 cards (incentive-promote/refer/drive/partner) plus incentives-promote-cta which routes to /login (unauthed) or /promote. (2) BusinessOnboarding step 3 shows businessModel-description + businessModel-help with all 5 model explanations (B2C/B2B/B2B2C/Marketplace/Subscription). (3) Admin Analytics tab now renders analytics-promotions card with promo-stat-paid/held/onboards/ambassadors and analytics-no-promoters empty-state — was crashing until the missing import was added. Currency switcher TT$/US$ present in navbar. Promoter APIs (/api/admin/promoters, /api/promoter/leaderboard) both return 200.
rca_of_the_issue: Root cause: AdminPanel.js referenced <AnalyticsPromotions/> JSX without importing it. React threw 'ReferenceError: AnalyticsPromotions is not defined' inside the Analytics tab render path, which the dev-mode error overlay caught and displayed as 'Uncaught runtime errors', preventing the tab from rendering at all. Reproduction: log in as owner admin -> /admin -> click 'Analytics' tab -> red overlay. Mitigation applied: added 'import AnalyticsPromotions from ./AnalyticsPromotions;' to AdminPanel.js. Verified post-fix: card renders, all 4 stat tiles present, analytics-no-promoters empty-state shown (expected, no promoter earnings yet), no console runtime errors.
